verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes GitHub Mobile as an app for reviewing PRs, managing Copilot agent tasks and triaging work, but never mentions an official SDK. The REST and GraphQL API docs are host-platform building blocks, not SDKs shipped by GitHub Mobile, so they earn no credit here. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404s.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
